headline: Angel One Overtakes Zerodha as India's Second-Largest Stockbroker
summary: Angel One added 2.43 lakh active clients in October, bringing its active client base to 69.99 lakh and overtaking Zerodha to become India's second-largest stockbroker with nearly 15% market share.
why: Shifts in market share among retail brokerage platforms highlight changing competitive dynamics within India's rapidly expanding financial services sector.

impacts.name: Angel One
impacts.why: Gaining market share and expanding the active client base strengthens the company's competitive position and revenue potential.
